official_name.value: Vienna University of Economics and Business (WU)

english_course_availability.notes: Over 350 English-taught courses per semester offered across business and economics (p. 3).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Minimum CEFR B2 English for Bachelor's exchange (C1 for Master's/PhD); WU does NOT require official language test certificates (home partner selection relied upon). RHET 1020 waiver not explicitly named, though certificate exemption simplifies eligibility.

host_language_requirement.value: None if taking English-taught courses; CEFR C1 German expected if selecting German-taught courses (no official certificate requested).

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Winter Semester: Pre-sem orientation Sep 7-8, 2026; Main Kickoff Sep 24-25, 2026; Teaching Oct 1, 2026-Jan 31, 2027.
fall_term_dates.notes: AY 2027-2028 Winter dates also published on WU_Factsheet_2728.pdf#page=2.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Summer Semester: Pre-sem orientation Feb 4-5, 2027; Main Kickoff Feb 22-23, 2027; Teaching Mar 1-Jun 27, 2027.
spring_term_dates.notes: AY 2027-2028 Summer dates also on WU_Factsheet_2728.pdf#page=2; 3-week ISUWU Summer University program (8 ECTS) detailed on p. 6.

tuition_model.notes: Partner exchange students receive a full tuition waiver at WU; only mandatory Austrian Students' Union (ÖH) dues (~€25-€26/semester) apply.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: WU Factsheet p. 5 total approx. €1,250-€2,050/month (Housing €450-900, ÖGK health ins €75, Food/personal €380, Utilities €40, Entertainment €100-200, plus semester transport €132-294, books €75-150, ÖH €25).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Midpoint 1650 EUR/month * 5 months * 1.1052 USD/EUR = 9117.90 USD (ECB reference rate dated 2026-11-13, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Austrian Students' Union (ÖH) dues: €25/semester (per Factsheet p. 5; ~€26 on wu.ac.at). Comprehensive health insurance required (ÖGK Student Self-Insurance ~€75/month per WU p. 5, €78.84/month per OeAD; entry travel insurance >=€30,000 needed for first month).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Entry travel insurance and ÖGK monthly rate verified on https://oead.at/en/to-austria/entry-and-residence/.

housing_availability.notes: WU has no on-campus dormitories, but International Office assists via OeAD Student Housing (pre-reserved rooms; registration fee waived with code 'WUINCOMING' per wu.ac.at) and other student residence providers.

housing_notes.value: Off-campus student residences (OeAD Student Housing promo 'WUINCOMING' waives registration fee per wu.ac.at) or private flats: €450-€900/month (from ~€437/month at OeAD).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Start 3-6 months prior (statutory decision period 90 days, extendable by 90 days). Non-EU stays up to 6 months require Visa D; >6 months require Residence Permit - Student. Monthly financial proof required by OeAD: €722.58/month (under age 24) or €1,308.39/month (age 24+), plus rent excess above €386.43/month.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: OeAD portal linked directly in WU_Factsheet_2728.pdf#page=5.

official_website_url.notes: Official WU International Office English portal listed on WU Fact Sheet p. 1 (Excel Col N was blank).

exchange_page_url.notes: Fact Sheet p. 1 also lists https://www.wu.ac.at/io/en.

course_catalog_url.notes: Direct filtered incoming-exchange eVVZ course catalog link from Factsheet p. 6 /Annots.

english_course_list_url.notes: Provides English filter over >350 English-taught courses/semester.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system: Bachelor load 24-30 ECTS/semester (Master 20-30 ECTS; max 36 ECTS excluding language courses). Austrian 1-5 grading scale (1 best, 5 fail).

course_restrictions_note.value: Bachelor exchange students may ONLY take Bachelor-level courses (Master students only Master-level); online 3-phase registration with preference submission (spots not guaranteed).

required_application_docs.notes: WU Factsheet p. 3 confirms no official language certificates are requested.

academic_style.value: Continuous-assessment 'PI' (prüfungs­immanent) coursework with mandatory attendance and group/project assessments rather than a dedicated final exam week.

international_support_services.value: ÖH Buddy Network, Pre-semester German course (2 ECTS, free + €40 admin fee), semester German (€245), optional Orientation & Cultural Program (€350), and OeAD housing support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Nominations: Winter May 1 (Full Year Apr 1), Summer Nov 1. Student pre-enrollment/application: Winter May 20, Summer Nov 20.
